comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Roofing membranes, insulation and roof coatings sold to roofing contractors and distributors match Owens Corning's roofing and insulation lines, though it is more diversified.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Roof coatings are a small part; main businesses are HVAC components, industrial valves and hoses, which differ from Owens Corning's products.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Specialty chemicals, polymers and fibers sold to manufacturers; it is a chemical producer, not a roofing or insulation maker.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Chlor-alkali chemicals and ammunition serve chemical plants, utilities and shooters, a different business from building products.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Structural connectors, anchors and fasteners share builder customers and dealer channels but are not roofing, insulation or glass products.
